parts.name: Refuse to Die
parts.desc: Goal: 10. After an ally monster dies, gain a counter. Reward: If it was non-DT, summon a copy of the monster that triggered this reward and reset this quest. If you have 10 or less HP, the quest resets with 5 counters.

parts.name: Save Point
parts.desc: Quest: In the face of death, you _Refuse to Die_. Delay: Summon an exact copy of the last ally that died this turn with full HP.
